reason: Pack aluminization supplies the Al absent from HfNbTaTiZr and can therefore plausibly generate a slow-growing Al2O3 barrier, with oxidation and mechanical retention directly testable against untreated controls. B improperly extrapolates the fluorine effect from Al-rich TiAl: because the target alloy contains no Al, fluorine cannot induce the cited protective alumina mechanism, while formation of a protective Hf/Nb/Ta mixed oxide is unsupported and speculative.
